paper.title: Joint Optimization of Wind Turbine Micrositing and Cabling in an Offshore Wind Farm
paper.authors: Siyu Tao and Qingshan Xu and Andrés Feijóo and Gang Zheng

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target paper, designated generic NSGA-III source and RTS-24 transcription inspected; no target MATLAB project, target BPSO package or result archive found

paper_source_conflicts: Equation 37's printed spacing expression conflicts with the explicit 500 m experimental spacing and grid.
Model 2 and Table VI specify 210 MW, but Fig. 7 labels the best-profit Model-2 layout Nwt=75.
Equation 37 lists AC-network constraints, but the stated quadprog inner model in Eqs. 42-43 retains only active balance, reserve and generator bounds.
The paper cites Yarpiz for BPSO but does not identify a binary implementation or encoding.
missing_information: target MATLAB project, exact target BPSO source/encoding, random states, repeat count, raw fronts, layouts and traces
raw Greater-Gabbard observations and numerical Figs. 3-5 arrays
target IEEE RTS modifications, AC/QP coupling, emission coefficients and quadprog options
price-correlation observations and several cable cost, loss and O&M constants
thrust curve and Gaussian entrainment constant
completion_decisions: Use the explicit native-experiment 500 m grid spacing and the consistent 70-turbine Model 2.
Digitize deterministic 24-hour winter/summer wind and load curves.
Use stable real-key grid decoding and 14 NSGA-III divisions yielding 120 reference directions.
Port the designated YPEA126 blend-crossover, Gaussian-mutation, normalization, association and niching semantics.
Reconstruct standard sigmoid BPSO with exact Table V parameters over a seven-bit closer-parent encoding that guarantees a radial tree.
Choose the least daily-cost feasible cable type for each decoded subtree flow.
Use the public RTS-24 generator cost lineage and analytic convex economic dispatch; do not claim missing AC-OPF.
Declare a fixed 50 MW reserve and version every absent physical/economic constant without numerical calibration.
Use one persistent full-core executor for candidates, dominance and association with schedule-independent random events.
Run all nine native profiles, 29 roles and 25 platform seeds at the paper maximum budgets after Waffle H6 admission.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of the target joint problem, NSGA-III/BPSO/QP method and every native paper role; not author source, original arrays, MATLAB trajectory or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: capacity in 3 MW increments and occupied cells on the 12 by 12 grid

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: one bounded real key per cell plus capacity key, stable top-N decode; seven BPSO bits per turbine select a closer parent

constraints_and_repair.resolution: unique occupied cells imply 500 m spacing, capacity 180-240 MW, radial connected cable tree, subtree flow and cable capacity

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize profit rate and mean capacity factor, minimize normalized daily variability; Model 3 selects profit only

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Gaussian wake, piecewise-linear turbine power, annualized turbine/cable/transformer economics, radial cable loss and convex RTS dispatch

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: deterministic 24-hour winter and summer figure digitizations with corresponding load profiles

paper_native_cases.resolution: nine unique profiles producing all 29 target reported roles; MOPSO comparison baseline excluded by project scope

initialization.resolution: counter-keyed uniform real keys and BPSO bits with one feasible sector-tree seed

parameters.resolution: all published physical, economic and algorithm parameters plus 14 reference divisions and 50 MW reserve

update_order.resolution: decode outer candidate, solve cable BPSO and dispatch, evaluate objectives, normalize/sort/associate/niching, blend crossover and Gaussian mutation

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: outer 120 by 250 and inner 100 by 250; per seed 331349 complete candidates, 8316859900 cable particles and 7952376 hourly wakes including 29 retained-role receipts

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: 29 roles per seed; objectives, capacity, cable cost/length, grid benefit, energy, full layouts/trees, physical work, timings, workers and hash; 25 platform seeds

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: NSGA-III, BPSO and QP have no learned model
